# std/index

> Indexing: a[i] for slices (assignable) and s[i] for strings (a u8).

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/index.pkg) · translated by [bintables/index](../bintables/index.md)

```
let a = make([int], 3)
a[0] = 7
print a[0]

let s = "hi"
print s[1] == 'i'     // true
```

An index outside `0 .. len - 1` stops the program with
`panic: index out of range`. String elements can be read but not
assigned: strings are immutable.

## Syntax

Kind: `postfix`, precedence 90, left-associative

```
{x: expr [T]} [ {i: expr int} ] -> T
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | expression | `[T]` |
| `i` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `T`

## Syntax

Kind: `postfix`, precedence 90, left-associative

```
{x: expr str} [ {i: expr int} ] -> u8
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | expression | `str` |
| `i` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `u8`
